protocol.acquisition: public body mass recompute and multibody forward_kinematics before first step; no time advances
protocol.first_row_inverse_inertia_scope: independently derived from pre-step native body Ixx under isolated isotropic/X/identity/COM-zero/zero-damping-armature assumptions; not captured native first-row LU
protocol.fixed_point: clip(-(independently f32-rounded rhs + pre native v)/(independently f32-rounded inverse I + independently f32-rounded g), native rounded +/-bound); native a/g bits compared separately; denominator evaluated after promotion to f64
protocol.fixture: fixed parent plus coincident 1 kg, radius 0.1 m isotropic sphere; revolute X
protocol.post_step_lu_scope: latest public augmented-mass LU.solve([1]); separately compared with derived pre-step inverse inertia, not relabelled first-row measurement
protocol.primary: N32/PGS1 nonzero signs for both gains: final first-slice impulse after PGS/stabilization2 against frozen-row fixed point; all eight zero targets stay motionless
protocol.source_scope: selected local source/configuration inputs, not an exhaustive compiler/dependency closure; lock/compiler/protocol are also bound externally before execution
protocol.state_scope: known rigid bodies sorted by handle and single native Multibody serialized individually with postcard raw wire format v1; private coords retained through source-bound serde layout; not all private pipeline state
protocol.truth_boundary: motor-only numerical calibration; no G1 contact, controller, kick, hardware or reliability inference
